notes: All seven relevant yeti extractions were considered. Support counts distinct videos describing the shared action or rule, including different quantities or situational timing; citations are representative. It does not count individual attacks or identical rosters.

No complete army repeats. The selected full roster is AAawYGfV-AE: its seven Super Yetis and two Baby Dragons match the current main composition in 3O9g9-Gujcw. The two five-Yeti sources use different hybrid armies, so there is no majority complete composition.

The selected roster's carried Sky Wagon and Troop Launcher entries are siege inventory, not additional troop deployments. Keep the single active Sky Wagon in cc; no Troop Launcher deployment is narrated.
The seven-Yeti plan uses the opening Giant Arrow shot described by 3O9g9-Gujcw, AAawYGfV-AE and g36z6N8CfTc. Other videos use later Queen abilities; the opening shot is not universal.

At t=0 means the opening deployment. All after/delay=0 links preserve narrated order where no elapsed delay is stated. They do not imply that the funnel clears instantly. Funnel completion has no exact trigger in this vocabulary; the main entry follows the siege setup without an invented wait.
Baby Dragon counts vary: two in the chosen seven-Yeti army, one in KDalGKrAyL0 and RPYN96e1hvE. RPYN96e1hvE introduces Duke before the Baby Dragon; the other three describe preparing his path first.

The Ice Golem precedes the main Yetis in KDalGKrAyL0 and g36z6N8CfTc; RPYN96e1hvE lists it after Yetis and Druids. Main support troops are deployed rapidly together, with differing internal order. Quantities follow the selected roster, and all means the remaining inventory.

Apprentice Warden and Super Wall Breaker deployment timing comes only from AAawYGfV-AE. The Barbarian, Archer and Valkyrie cleanup counts are known there, but their precise deployment instructions are not; no cleanup steps are invented.

edge:charge and edge:funnel approximate the two narrated flanks. Current Rust spreads the Super Yeti main deployment as a line; the transcript does not recover its exact tiles. The Yeti review verifies line deployment.

inside:Barbarian King approximates middle/deeper/back-end wall access. group_inside:main approximates an advancing push. heavy_fire approximates heavy damage, defense lock-on, or using protection as needed; no health fraction, radius or repeat interval is invented.

Threat-based Freeze and Totem steps combine different narrated targets. Logger, cake and hot candle are not confidently identified; no building key is invented for them. Skeleton uses the explicitly identified Monolith; 3O9g9-Gujcw also allows another distraction when it is too deep.

Ice Blocks should affect Dragon Duke without catching the surrounding army (dMcpXZ_wc8Q, 497.0). Additional Ice Blocks, Freezes and Totems are narrated, but no common repeat interval is stated, so the executable policy does not invent one.

Current Rust resolves the actual fallen Duke position for Revive, including the legacy edge:charge steps. Both revival steps require a dead Duke; the second also follows the first. Surplus spells can use fallback. The Yeti step audit verifies corpse positioning and surplus Revive behavior.

Poison use is contested: 3O9g9-Gujcw saves it against an Ice-Golem-only CC without Furnace, while g36z6N8CfTc explicitly Poisons emerging Ice Golems. The generic defenders trigger cannot distinguish CC composition; choose that situational policy when selecting the plan.

Early Warden activation is common. AAawYGfV-AE recommends delaying Torch against early defending Ice Golems; dMcpXZ_wc8Q separately waits for the last friendly Ice Golem to die. The delayed-Torch variant represents the friendly case only. 3O9g9-Gujcw describes Torch as active without narrating a manual activation.

Siege variants require matching active siege inventory and, for the later Queen ability, the corresponding Queen loadout. RPYN96e1hvE's introduction says Siege Barracks, while its later narration and army link say Sky Wagon; its two Sky Wagons are inventory, not two deployments. Log Launcher is used by Z9mIhJiByqE and permitted by g36z6N8CfTc. Its precise deployment time is unspecified, so the variant uses the siege setup slot with zero delay.

The Invisibility variant requires an alternate spell loadout; the selected army has no Invisibility Spell. Z9mIhJiByqE and g36z6N8CfTc describe protecting a Duke charge, while KDalGKrAyL0 separately discusses using Invisibility to force Duke inward. No fixed repeat interval is supplied.

KDalGKrAyL0 alternative: 5 Super Yetis, 2 Electro Titans, 3 Druids, 1 Ice Golem, 1 Apprentice Warden, 1 Super Wall Breaker, 1 Baby Dragon, 1 Wizard, 1 Headhunter and 2 Archers; 2 Totems, 2 Rages, 1 Freeze, 1 Invisibility and 3 Ice Blocks; CC 2 Ruin Witches, 2 Archers, 1 Goblin and 2 Revives with Siege Barracks or Log Launcher inventory. Its narrated main order is Ice Golem, Yetis, Electro Titans, King, Warden, Druids.

RPYN96e1hvE alternative: 5 Super Yetis, 2 Ruin Witches, 2 Druids, 2 Ice Golems, 1 Apprentice Warden, 1 Inferno Dragon, 1 Baby Dragon, 1 Balloon, 1 Wizard, 1 Headhunter and 3 Archers; 3 Freezes, 1 Poison, 2 Revives, 2 Totems and 1 Skeleton; CC 2 Ice Golems, 1 P.E.K.K.A and 4 Ice Blocks with Sky Wagon inventory. Ruin Witch deployment timing is unclear. 3O9g9-Gujcw also describes an earlier five-Yeti/two-Ruin-Witch composition.

g36z6N8CfTc alternative: 8 Super Yetis, 2 Ice Golems, 1 Apprentice Warden, 1 Druid and 3 Minions; 2 Revives, 2 Invisibilities, 2 Rages and 1 Poison; CC 1 Super Yeti, 1 Super Valkyrie, 3 Totems and 1 Freeze, with Sky Wagon and Troop Launcher inventory. It deploys an opening Totem before Ice Golems and Yetis, and also describes Sky Wagon with the main army rather than exclusively with Queen.

3O9g9-Gujcw supplies only a partial seven-Yeti roster; dMcpXZ_wc8Q gives two Revives but leaves most quantities unstated. Z9mIhJiByqE combines TH15-18 variations with unstated troop totals, Log Launcher, changing CC troops, five or six Revives in some versions and Invisibility in later versions. These incomplete inventories are not filled with invented counts.

Loadouts differ: KDalGKrAyL0 and RPYN96e1hvE use Magic Mirror/Action Figure on Queen; g36z6N8CfTc uses Magic Mirror/Giant Arrow, Electro Fangs/Fire Heart on Duke and Snake Bracelet on King; Z9mIhJiByqE names Volcanic Heart in its initial setup and later describes Queen-spawned Healers. The selected army retains AAawYGfV-AE's complete loadouts.

Source actions wait and Main army in Z9mIhJiByqE have no literal executable action/unit in the permitted vocabulary, so they are not emitted as steps. Town Hall-side and opposite-Town-Hall entries both occur; no universal compass direction or fixed Town Hall distance is inferred.

PB1b: recipe selects an explicit named source/variant; an ambiguous inventory retains repair-only selection. packet preserves the input action clock, primary marks the main cohort, objective binds one building, and effect prerequisites use actual cast expiry. Source inventory/loadout and frame-verification holds remain in force. These are controller policies and synthetic regression evidence, not real-game calibration.
